assumptions: Both buildings are assigned to the existing traced roof proxies and their plaza-facing western edges. Roof displacement and 5 m assumed georeferencing uncertainty remain; the assignment is adopted, not surveyed.
Existing 20 m / 28 m proxy roof heights remain assumed total masses. Lower frontage, tower setback, door/window modules and steps are construction choices informed by photographs.
Pale neutral mineral wall colours, dark metal and green-grey glazing are selected for a coherent full-colour reconstruction. Black-and-white photographs do not prove these colours.
Fountain shape and location are inferred from the aerial; dimensions and lamp positions remain modeling assumptions. The three lamp positions are not claimed as measured historical pole positions.
Use stable building names and neutral poster panels. No actual programme, event, or exact day in 1976 is invented.
Current DEM supplies a continuous ground datum. It is a modern terrain reference rather than a verified 1976 pavement elevation.
The seven-globe count and crown dimensions are an adopted procedural simplification of the multi-globe lamp style; no exact pole inventory or measured globe count is claimed.
Toho canopy underside is adopted at 4.15 m above plaza grade so the 1.2 m stair rise and 2.7 m door opening do not intersect it; Plaza lettering baseline 4.55 m is an authored placement.

After fitting actual CJK glyph bounds, place Koma Toho lettering centre at 3.9 m and Plaza Theatre lettering centre at 4.95 m so their 0.85 m glyph bounds clear the canopy tops; these are authored layout dimensions.
